acceptanceCriteria: Pairs are reported with the shared assertion lines and score; frequent lines are excluded by a cutoff.
Gate mode considers only pairs involving the branch's added or changed tests.
A distinct-from decision with a reason resolves a pair; one without a reason does not.
Marking an obligation covered-by another test resolves the pair.
Output states that pairs are candidates, not verdicts.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1035 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem Different authors write tests proving the same behaviour in different words and files, so titles and descriptions miss the duplication. Current workaround Normalized assertion lines are extracted per test. Pairs across files that share at least two lines above a Jaccard threshold are flagged, ignoring lines that appear in many tests. A branch gate compares the tests it adds or changes against the base and fails until each pair has a decision: a reasoned distinct-from note, or removal with the obligation marked covered-by the other test. Proposal `corvint tests duplicates [--ref REV] [--gate TICKET]`. See beamfall/corvint#1035 for the full text.
title: tests duplicates: detect duplicate tests by assertion-set similarity, with recorded distinct-from decisions (issue #1035)
